sets.name: _StepperBase
sets.desc: Steps in the Platforms Code exhibit three behaviors depending on user interaction.

sets.name: Progress Indicator
sets.desc: The Steps UI element facilitates step-by-step navigation through a process or sequence, commonly used in forms or multi-step processes to guide users systematically. It provides clear visual cues, indicating the current step, to help users understand their progress and the steps they've completed.
